expected_behaviour.then: Reason, evidence, confidence, impact and success criteria are present
Accept, pause, reject and review-later actions are available

forbidden_behaviour.given: AI creates a recommendation
forbidden_behaviour.then: No configuration is changed without explicit human approval

expected_behaviour.then: Required translation work may be created
It may appear as an AI recommendation but not as an error or required task

forbidden_behaviour.then: No translation task is generated for it

expected_behaviour.then: Manifest, Worker, registry, cache keys and notes use the same release identity
Visible timestamp represents completed build time

forbidden_behaviour.then: No active runtime file contains a stale release identity

forbidden_behaviour.given: A release is packaged
forbidden_behaviour.then: No deployable static asset exceeds Cloudflare limit

expected_behaviour.given: A feature requests a registered AI capability
expected_behaviour.then: The capability contract and configured policy are returned
The service returns an explainable unavailable state without executing externally

forbidden_behaviour.given: A feature requests an unknown capability
forbidden_behaviour.then: The request is blocked and no silent fallback occurs

forbidden_behaviour.given: The foundation release is active
forbidden_behaviour.then: No feature or service is bound directly to a named provider or model

forbidden_behaviour.given: A high-risk AI capability is requested
forbidden_behaviour.when: No governed provider and approval policy are active
forbidden_behaviour.then: No automatic external action is executed

expected_behaviour.given: A platform component publishes an event
expected_behaviour.then: Only a registered channel-neutral event type is accepted
The event contains trace, privacy, validation, source and context metadata

expected_behaviour.given: The same idempotency key is published twice
expected_behaviour.then: The original event is returned without duplicate processing

forbidden_behaviour.given: A new touchpoint emits an event
forbidden_behaviour.then: The event name must not encode a specific vendor or channel implementation

forbidden_behaviour.given: An unknown event type is requested
forbidden_behaviour.then: Publication is rejected with an explainable validation error

forbidden_behaviour.given: An interaction may contain personal data
forbidden_behaviour.then: Privacy classification and retention must be declared

expected_behaviour.given: A consumer requests a registered canonical contract
expected_behaviour.when: The Schema Registry resolves id and version
expected_behaviour.then: The exact versioned contract is returned with owner, layer and compatibility policy

forbidden_behaviour.given: A consumer requests an unknown contract or version
forbidden_behaviour.then: The request is rejected and no implicit schema is invented

forbidden_behaviour.given: An entity has a human-readable display name
forbidden_behaviour.then: A stable identifier is used instead of the display name

expected_behaviour.when: The Data Contracts service creates an envelope
expected_behaviour.then: Schema version, provenance, privacy purpose, retention and trace metadata are present

forbidden_behaviour.given: A data object is shared across capabilities
forbidden_behaviour.when: It is represented as canonical platform data
forbidden_behaviour.then: It must not be accepted without a registered contract and schema version

forbidden_behaviour.given: Data is classified as personal or sensitive
forbidden_behaviour.then: A retention policy and explicit processing purpose are required

expected_behaviour.given: An experience begins in any channel
expected_behaviour.then: A shared context uses canonical channel-neutral identifiers and an explicit TTL
Only registered fields are merged and provenance remains governed
It is no longer returned as active

forbidden_behaviour.given: Experience context is created
forbidden_behaviour.then: No persistent identity profile or cross-channel identity link is created

forbidden_behaviour.given: A component attempts to store direct personal data
forbidden_behaviour.then: The field is rejected by the context boundary

forbidden_behaviour.given: A new domain uses the context engine
forbidden_behaviour.then: Platform Core does not require domain-specific fields

contracts.description: A release verdict must be based on observed behaviour and complete evidence, not only structural presence.

expected_behaviour.given: A capability declares runtime, risk and visibility metadata
expected_behaviour.then: All mandatory test levels are derived and required before release

expected_behaviour.given: A user-visible asynchronous capability is changed
expected_behaviour.then: A real browser observes loading settle into success, empty, error or timeout

expected_behaviour.given: A critical integration dependency is removed or renamed
expected_behaviour.then: At least one verification test fails and the mutation is rejected

expected_behaviour.given: A required test cannot run or its evidence is absent
expected_behaviour.then: The verdict is incomplete_evidence and the release is not approved

forbidden_behaviour.given: A user-visible component remains in loading state
forbidden_behaviour.then: The release cannot be marked verified

forbidden_behaviour.given: Files, functions and containers exist but runtime behaviour is not observed
forbidden_behaviour.then: The capability cannot be marked verified

forbidden_behaviour.given: Verification outcome is unknown or inconclusive
forbidden_behaviour.then: The result is incomplete_evidence rather than pass

forbidden_behaviour.given: A quality judgement requires human assessment
forbidden_behaviour.then: It is explicitly classified as manual review and never reported as automated verification

contracts.description: Improvements must follow a governed, evidence-based lifecycle from observation to measured learning.

expected_behaviour.then: Evidence, confidence, expected value, risk and measurable success criteria are present

expected_behaviour.given: An improvement has high or critical risk
expected_behaviour.then: Explicit human approval is required
Verification and before/after measurement occur before learning is recorded
The lifecycle cannot skip required evidence stages

forbidden_behaviour.given: AI proposes an improvement without evidence
forbidden_behaviour.then: The improvement is rejected

forbidden_behaviour.given: A high-risk action lacks approval
forbidden_behaviour.then: Implementation is blocked

forbidden_behaviour.given: No before/after evidence exists
forbidden_behaviour.then: The platform cannot claim improvement or record learning

expected_behaviour.then: Evidence, confidence, value, effort, risk, owner and verification are present

expected_behaviour.given: An action has medium, high or critical risk
expected_behaviour.then: Human approval is required before execution
The user can see why it matters and the next governed step

forbidden_behaviour.given: Evidence or verification is missing
forbidden_behaviour.then: Action cannot be VERIFIED or executed

forbidden_behaviour.given: An action changes status
forbidden_behaviour.then: Required lifecycle stages cannot be skipped

forbidden_behaviour.given: An action is high or critical risk
forbidden_behaviour.then: AI cannot execute without explicit human approval
